data.body: Coordination note (2026-09-07): open bug trustful-combative-grackle (9c64-7582-ffad-4fea, "no invariant ties test.yml sweep-lane extras to the gating lane's extras") names `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` as the file that should have caught the drift. This story deletes 11 tests from that module and rewrites one. If the bug's fix adds a new invariant, it should go in as its own test function with a bug-anchored docstring (the KEEP class this story preserves), not by reviving one of the 11 snapshot tests; whichever lands second rebases onto the other.
